desc: negative: Redirect multiport: dummy egress -> dev1 ingress -> dummy egress (Loop)
pre: ip link add v0p1 type veth peer name v0p0 && ip link set v0p1 up && ip link set v0p0 up
ip link add dummy1 type dummy && ip link set dummy1 up
ip link set dev dummy1 up || true
ip addr add 10.10.10.10/24 dev dummy1 || true
tc qdisc add dev dummy1 clsact
tc filter add dev dummy1 egress protocol ip prio 10 matchall action mirred ingress redirect dev v0p1 index 1
tc qdisc add dev v0p1 clsact
tc filter add dev v0p1 ingress protocol ip prio 10 matchall action mirred egress redirect dev dummy1 index 2

readback.cmd: tc -j -s actions get action mirred index 1
readback.name: verify
